Coursework:

1. DS-GA 1009: Practical Training for Data Science (typically an internship) within the first year (3 credits)
2. Two approved electives (6 credits) from Big Data or Natural Language Processing courses

These requirements are in addition to the general requirements of the MS in Data Science program [1][2][3][4].

No, evening classes are not guaranteed. The FAQ states, "we try to schedule required courses in the evenings, but this is not guaranteed. No, continuous enrollment does not apply in the summer. Students are required to be continuously enrolled every fall and spring semester. This requirement does not extend to the summer semester [2].
